metadata.compilation_notes: Protocol compiled from Zhou et al. 2020, ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces 12, 29876-29882. DOI: 10.1021/acsami.0c01064. Key inferred parameter: reflux temperature (78C, ethanol boiling point) in S14. Missing parameters: stirring speed (multiple steps), centrifuge parameters (S12), hydrothermal ramp rate and cooling method (S07), wash solvent volumes (S05, S13), variable growth time (S11). All missing parameters are medium or low risk; no high-risk blocking parameters. Protocol status: needs_review.

safety_checks.message: Step S07 involves sealed autoclave heating at 200C. Saturated steam pressure at 200C is ~1.6 MPa. Teflon-lined autoclave is standard equipment for hydrothermal synthesis, but pressure rating must be confirmed.
Step S07 hydrothermal temperature 200C reaches the 200C high-temperature threshold. Confirm autoclave temperature rating and safety measures.
Step S14 involves ethanol reflux at ~78C (inferred). Ethanol flash point is 13C. Reflux condenser and fume hood required.
Step S09 uses ammonia solution (25 wt%, 0.20 mL). Ammonia is a respiratory irritant. Fume hood required.
Step S14 uses ammonia solution (1 mL, 25 wt%) during reflux. Ammonia vapors will be generated at reflux temperature. Fume hood and condenser required.
Step S07 heating to 200C without specified ramp rate. Default 5C/min may be too fast for sealed autoclave.
Step S14 reflux temperature (78C) is an inferred parameter based on ethanol boiling point. Requires human confirmation before execution.
Step S01 uses anhydrous ethanol (80 mL) at room temperature. Below flash point risk but flammable. Standard handling.
Step S01 uses tetrabutyl titanate (TBT) which is moisture-sensitive. Anhydrous ethanol is specified, which is appropriate.
Step S10 uses TEOS which is moisture-sensitive. Ammonia serves as catalyst for hydrolysis.
Step S14 uses methyltrimethoxysilane (MTMS) which is moisture-sensitive. Ammonia catalyzes hydrolysis/condensation.
